entries.o: <fe><02><0a><32><32><33><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>It would've been nice\nif we found something.
<fe><02><0a><32><32><33><62><5f><30><30><32><37><00>Sorry 'bout that! I'll\ntry to be more careful.
<fe><02><0a><32><32><33><62><5f><30><30><33><32><00>But at least we weren't\npermanently petrified.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><32><33><62><5f><30><30><33><33><00>Ordinarily, after\ngetting hit...
<fe><02><0a><32><32><33><62><5f><30><30><33><39><00>Um, I think it's best\nthat we get going.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><32><33><62><5f><30><30><34><30><00>Who knows when another\ndemon will show up.
<fe><02><0a><32><32><34><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>I think it was the right\ndecision to come here.
<fe><02><0a><32><32><34><62><5f><30><30><32><34><00>It seems we have no choice\nbut to fight.
<fe><02><0a><32><32><34><62><5f><30><30><34><33><00>Well I couldn't have\ndone it without you.
<fe><02><0a><32><32><34><62><5f><30><30><34><39><00>Uh, am I the only one who's\nnot thrilled by the idea?
<fe><02><0a><32><32><34><62><5f><30><30><35><34><00>Just don't blame me if\nanything happens this time!
<fe><02><0e><74><62><6f><78><5f><39><36><34><5f><30><30><30><31><00>You did it! You prevented\nthe lock from activating!
<fe><02><0a><32><33><32><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>I was afraid you'd say\nsomething like that.
<fe><02><0a><32><33><32><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>It's quiet, but I have\nthis strange feeling...
<fe><02><0a><32><33><33><62><5f><30><30><31><31><00>It seems we have no choice\nbut to fight.
<fe><02><0a><32><33><33><62><5f><30><30><31><37><00>Can we really handle this\non our own?
<fe><02><0a><32><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>But will we even have\na chance to train?
<fe><02><0a><32><33><33><62><5f><30><30><33><34><00>To start a training battle,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><33><33><62><5f><30><30><33><35><00>just press the SELECT button\nand choose ¤Practice.¤
<fe><02><0a><32><33><33><62><5f><30><30><33><39><00>But we still get items\nfor winning, right?
<fe><02><0a><32><33><33><63><5f><30><30><33><32><00>Maybe it'll fall if we\nshake the tree.
<fe><02><0a><32><33><33><63><5f><30><30><35><35><00>If you don't want it,\nthen give it to Lina!
<fe><02><0a><32><33><33><63><5f><30><30><35><36><00>On second thought... Just\nkidding. You can have it.
<fe><02><0a><32><33><33><63><5f><30><30><36><35><00>An enemy could be hiding\nin the shadows.
<fe><02><0a><32><33><33><63><5f><30><30><37><35><00>It's no big deal. We use it\nall the time for cooking.
<fe><02><0a><32><33><33><63><5f><30><30><37><37><00>Something tells me Lina\ndoesn't help in the kitchen.
<fe><02><0a><32><33><34><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>We HAVE come across a lot\nof demons so far.
<fe><02><0a><32><33><34><62><5f><30><30><35><30><00>One thing's for sure,\nsecurity here is tight.
<fe><02><0a><32><33><34><62><5f><30><31><34><31><00>(Actually, they're less\nlikely to harm a child.)
<fe><02><0a><32><33><34><62><5f><30><31><36><32><00>Nice work, Ein!\nI knew I could count on you.
<fe><02><0a><32><33><34><62><5f><30><31><36><37><00>Nice work, Ein!\nI knew I could count on you.
<fe><02><0a><32><34><32><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Despite how old it is,\nit still looks brand new.
<fe><02><0a><32><34><32><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>That just shows how well\nit was kept.
<fe><02><0a><32><34><32><62><5f><30><30><31><38><00>Purifying his remains will\nfree this poor man's soul.
<fe><02><0a><32><34><32><62><5f><30><30><33><32><00>I don't think there's\nanything Lina can do...
<fe><02><0a><32><34><32><62><5f><30><30><34><30><00>Yeah, we might get cursed\nif we're not careful!
<fe><02><0a><32><34><33><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>Yeah, I'm tired of bein'\nblown around like a leaf...
<fe><02><0a><32><34><34><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>It's dark here. The shadows\ncan play tricks on you.
<fe><02><0a><32><35><32><63><5f><30><30><33><32><00>We'll deal with him later.\nFirst, let's find a way down.
<fe><02><0a><32><35><32><63><5f><30><30><33><36><00>Um, let's concentrate on\ngetting down from here.
<fe><02><0a><32><35><32><63><5f><30><30><34><33><00>It looks like we can get\ndown from here.

<fe><02><0a><32><35><33><61><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Of course. That glowing orb\nis called the moon.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><35><33><61><5f><30><30><32><36><00>Though, it's quite far away\nfrom Riviera.
<fe><02><0a><32><35><33><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>It seems we have no choice\nbut to fight.
<fe><02><0a><32><35><33><62><5f><30><30><32><33><00>If we jump, we won't be\nable to get back here.
<fe><02><0a><32><35><34><61><5f><30><30><30><30><00>There's an open window we\ncould jump through.
<fe><02><0a><32><35><34><61><5f><30><30><30><39><00>It may be a demon.\nStay alert, everyone.
<fe><02><0a><32><35><34><61><5f><30><30><31><38><00>Don't step on a crack or you'll\nbreak your momma's back<a2><51>
<fe><02><0a><32><35><34><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>...We should be careful,\nor our luck will run out.
<fe><02><09><65><31><31><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Is it me, or are the\nghosts multiplying?
<fe><02><0a><32><36><32><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>I'm not sure what it was...\nI only caught a glimpse.
<fe><02><0a><32><36><33><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>They don't seem evil<fc><4a>\nthey seem more... friendly.
<fe><02><0a><32><36><33><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>It seems we have no choice\nbut to fight.
<fe><02><0a><32><36><33><62><5f><30><30><31><39><00>But we can't just leave\nthings like this!
<fe><02><0a><32><36><33><62><5f><30><30><33><34><00>This spear... I think it\nbelonged to a demon...
<fe><02><0a><32><36><33><62><5f><30><30><33><39><00>This is the only statue\nthat has one.
<fe><02><0a><32><36><34><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>I wanted to come. So\ndon't blame yourselves.
<fe><02><0a><32><36><34><62><5f><30><30><32><32><00>They're pictures of demons.\nBut why are they here?
<fe><02><0a><32><37><32><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>It was faint, but I think\nI heard something.
<fe><02><0a><32><37><32><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>You heard it too?\nWhat do you think it was?
<fe><02><0a><32><37><32><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>What!? No, it didn't.\nIt sounded like a clang!
<fe><02><0a><32><37><32><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>Did you really hear it,\nor are you just pretending?
<fe><02><0a><32><37><33><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>It seems we have no choice\nbut to fight.
<fe><02><0a><32><37><33><63><5f><30><30><30><30><00>The water's so clear\nI can see the bottom.
<fe><02><0a><32><37><34><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>Then prepare to lose your\nsouls to this ¤demon¤!
